name: Totonou Sauna
description: Totonou Sauna — a neighbourhood public sauna theme built as a card mosaic: the rooms on the home page share one grid of rectangular cards (an intro card, a tall stove-room card, the plunge and roof cards, a wide löyly card and a water photograph). A formal top header: the sauna name and tagline on the left, the Book a slot button and a Menu button on the right; the menu always opens as a full-screen ouni orange overlay with large numbered entries. Ouni orange (#EE7948) is the main colour: the hero, the story band, every page head and the overlay menu are solid orange fields set in dark sauna ink. The hero is a vertical banner: a tall hanging banner photograph of the steam room on a rod, beside the giant title, lead, buttons and today's sauna list; the cut-out wooden sauna bucket (transparent WebP) hangs over the banner edge and breaks below the hero, and a cut-out felt sauna hat breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a documentary-style photograph (35mm wide angle, available light, fine grain) graded toward ouni orange. Mochiy Pop P One for display, Red Hat Text for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-9 (card-mosaic, vertical-banner hero, overlay nav, real-photography, documentary, ouni #EE7948, Mochiy Pop P One + Red Hat Text, health-wellness). A formal top header with the sauna name, tagline, Book a slot button and an always-on Menu button that opens the full-screen overlay. Break-frame: the cut-out wooden bucket breaks over the hero banner edge and the hero bottom, and the cut-out felt hat over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 黃丹橘的街坊三溫暖：直式垂幕照片主視覺、去背木桶破格而出、全螢幕覆蓋選單、卡片拼貼的設施介紹，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: An ouni orange neighbourhood sauna: a hanging banner photo hero, a cut-out bucket breaking out, an overlay menu and a card mosaic.
summary.ja: 黄丹色の町のサウナ。縦長の垂れ幕写真、枠を越える木桶の切り抜き、全画面メニュー、カードのモザイク。
summary.fr: Un sauna de quartier orange ouni : bannière photo verticale, seau détouré qui déborde, menu plein écran et mosaïque de cartes.
summary.de: Eine Nachbarschaftssauna in Ouni-Orange: hängendes Bannerfoto, freigestellter Eimer bricht aus, Vollbildmenü und Kartenmosaik.
